    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AdaptiveBackoff
    Computes backoff delays that adapt to observed contention.
    AegisClient
    Cockroach Aegis client: read-first access to autonomous-ops findings and recommendations, plus an AegisClient.emit(AppEvent) channel for app telemetry.
    AegisConfig
    Configuration for the Cockroach Aegis client.
    AegisFactory
    SPI for creating AegisClient instances.
    AgentTool
    Marks the annotated method as an agent-callable tool.
    AnomalyClassifier
    Maps raw SQLExceptions onto the typed CrdbAnomaly hierarchy and decides retryability, based on SQLSTATE.
    AppEvent
    An application-level operational signal emitted to Cockroach Aegis (the "exhaust").
    CircuitBreaker
    Wraps the annotated method in a circuit breaker.
    CircuitBreaker
    A thread-safe circuit breaker.
    CircuitOpen
    Signals that a circuit breaker is OPEN and the call was rejected without being attempted.
    ConnectionAnomaly
    A connection-level failure (SQLSTATE class 08), e.g.
    ConnectionCallback<T>
    A unit of work executed against an open, in-transaction Connection.
    Crdb
    The one-stop entry point for the CockroachDB pure-Java library.
    CrdbAnomaly
    A typed CockroachDB failure.
    CrdbConfig
    Immutable library configuration.
    CrdbContext
    Access point for the current CrdbContextValues, bound via ScopedValue so it is safe under virtual threads and structured concurrency.
    CrdbContextValues
    Immutable bundle of CockroachDB call context.
    CrdbEventListener
    Receives operational events emitted by the library's retry and circuit-breaker machinery.
    CrdbEvents
    Process-wide event bus and counters for CockroachDB operational signals.
    CrdbException
    Unchecked, typed failure that wraps a CrdbAnomaly.
    CrdbProxyFactory
    Produces enhanced instances of annotated targets.
    CrdbProxyFactory.Interceptor
    ByteBuddy interception target.
    CrdbRetry
    Retries the annotated method on CockroachDB serialization anomalies (SQLSTATE 40001 / 40P01) using adaptive exponential backoff.
    CrdbStats
    A snapshot of process-wide operational counters.
    Finding
    A Cockroach Aegis finding: something the autonomous-ops agents observed about a cluster.
    FollowerRead
    Marks the annotated method as a follower-read call.
    Isolation
    Transaction isolation levels supported by CockroachDB.
    OriginalCall
    A call to the original (un-enhanced) method body.
    Recommendation
    A Cockroach Aegis recommendation: a suggested action derived from findings.
    Region
    Pins the annotated method's execution to a CockroachDB region.
    RetryEngine
    Executes a unit of work, retrying on retryable CockroachDB anomalies with AdaptiveBackoff.
    RetryEngine.Sleeper
    Abstracts sleeping so tests can run without real delays.
    RetryExhausted
    Signals that the retry engine gave up after exhausting all attempts.
    RetryPolicy
    Immutable retry configuration.
    SerializationConflict
    A serialization conflict (SQLSTATE 40001, or the deadlock variant 40P01).
    State
    Circuit breaker states.
    StorageInsights
    Read-only Cockroach Plenum storage insights.
    StorageInsightsFactory
    SPI for creating StorageInsights instances.
    TableStorage
    Storage usage for a single table (Cockroach Plenum insight).
    Transactional
    Runs the annotated method inside a JDBC transaction (SERIALIZABLE by default).
    TransactionTemplate
    Runs ConnectionCallbacks inside a managed JDBC transaction.
    UnknownAnomaly
    Any failure that does not map to a more specific CrdbAnomaly.
    VirtualCluster
    Routes the annotated method to a Cockroach vCluster (virtual cluster) for workload isolation on shared capacity.
    VirtualClusterScope
    A context-scoped executor for a Cockroach vCluster.
    Workload
    Tags the annotated method's workload priority/class for a Cockroach vCluster.
    Workload.Priority
    Relative importance of a workload sharing a virtual cluster.
